slides.title: 從例子學規律，再預測新情況
slides.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: complete Traditional Chinese teaching slide for a 10-slide self-study deck, wide landscape 16:9.
Primary request: Redesign the educational content below as an elegant, precise visual explanation. Enough context to learn independently, very little prose, every figure explains a relationship.
Style: clean editorial textbook infographic, warm off-white background, dark navy type, teal inputs, amber answers, coral errors, muted blue models; crisp flat illustrations with subtle paper texture, fine outlines, generous whitespace. Consistent restrained visual language. No mascots, robots, decorative icons, shiny badges, thick pill-shaped titles, gradients or 3D effects.
Composition: modest heading at upper left (about 6% of height), one short subtitle, large explanatory figures occupying about 65% of slide, concise takeaway strip at bottom, small page number lower right. Labels comfortably readable. All Chinese in Traditional Chinese Taiwan usage. Render only the exact quoted text specified below plus mathematical symbols and numerical labels explicitly requested. Preserve conceptual accuracy; no invented claims. Do not add extra paragraphs.

Text (verbatim), title: "從例子學規律，再預測新情況"
Subtitle: "機器學習：用資料調整模型"
Content and figure specification: Central left-to-right diagram: a stack of historical drink-shop records with small weather / calendar / cups illustrations labelled "過去紀錄＋答案" → a model with a few visible adjustable controls labelled "訓練模型" → new weather/calendar input labelled "新的天氣與日期" entering a second instance of the trained model → drink cups labelled "預估銷量". Visually distinguish the training flow from the use flow with two aligned rows. At lower left a small nested rectangle set accurately shows "人工智慧" containing "機器學習" containing "神經網路". Bottom takeaway exact text: "模型學的是資料中的規律；預測仍可能出錯。" Page "01 / 10".
